Package io.github.protasm.jvmud.execution

package io.github.protasm.jvmud.execution
Application operation, the game model, and hosted mudlib execution.

application owns startup, endpoints, worker supervision, and installation updates. model defines worlds, identities, time, and mudlib contracts. instance assembles those contracts with the language runtime inside one mudlib worker. These are responsibility boundaries; packages alone do not enforce process isolation.
